This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

story_quest:EntityPackIdErr.source_en: Entity: {0}, Deployment ID: {1} error. The current scene deployment {2} does not match and cannot be created.

uncertain:DungeonDetection.source_en: Weekly Challenge: Gate of the Lost Star
Weekly Challenge: Seed of Illusory Origin
Weekly Challenge: Statue of the Crownless

story_quest:AvoidBlock.source_en: Score as many points as possible

uncertain:keyActivity.source_en: Complete Spindrift Tasks to earn Spindrifts, which can be exchanged for various rewards.

uncertain:TaskOccupyGeneralDes.source_en: Quest impacted by environment. Cannot continue.
You are in Co-op Mode. Quest occupied. Cannot continue.

uncertain:GlobalFliterOpenTips.source_en: Available only while characters are in idle state.

story_quest:Flow.source_en: I'm Shui, an honorary member of the Overdash Club.

uncertain:phone.source_en: Huanglong is made up of the capital and six cities. As the youngest among them, Jinzhou is a key fortress guarding the border, a frontline against Tacet Discords.
Under the blessing of Sentinel Jué and the protection of the Midnight Rangers, Jinzhou has forged a unique cultural character despite its perilous surroundings.

story_quest:Event.source_en: Wait! Zhezhi, don't tell me you plan on finishing all that by yourself?
But there are so many requests... Darling, I can't let you do all of this alone.

story_quest:PKDSJ.source_en: Woo-hoo! Master, is there any other place you want to go?
Use the portals to connect the device and the core.

story_quest:POI.source_en: This Hoartoise is getting mobbed by other Tacet Discords... Looks like it really needs help.
Seems like it wants to take me somewhere. I should follow it and see what's going on there.
Why is it fighting with the Tacet Discords again...

story_quest:Chengxiaoshan.source_en: {PlayerName}, did you hear that? My stomach is growling.
How about we go to that place we went to last time with Yangyang and Chixia?

story_quest:NPC.source_en: Don't be scared, mommy's here. Shall we go home now?
Um... I wanna play a while longer... Please?

story_quest:Side.source_en: Yep, all of them, exactly the amount you asked for.
Hold it, man. Be patient. We need to see the money first…

story_quest:Daily.source_en: My stomach hurts... I got food poisoning from accidentally eating the wrong herb to be more precise.

story_quest:Daliy.source_en: Check out these stones... All mined from Jinzhou!
Our company's stones are top-notch and budget-friendly, with a wide range of options to choose from... And we can even deliver them right to your doorstep...
Hey, it's you, {PlayerName}. Come, grab a drink.

story_quest:Character.source_en: ...The Weiqi pieces were scattered, but the guru remained calm. "It's getting late," he said gently to the woodcutter. "Shouldn't you be heading down the mountain?"

As he glanced at the sky, the woodcutter was shocked to see how much time had passed. "It couldn't have been more than two hours," he thought in disbelief. Feeling apologetic, he prepared to leave, worried that the guru would be annoyed with him.

But when the woodcutter turned around, he nearly jumped out of his skin. The hermit guru, who had been playing Weiqi and drinking wine, was now gone. In his place lay a shattered Weiqi board and a heap of decaying bones.

story_quest:RG.source_en: We meet again, but you don't look very well.
Relax. From now on, you will only hear my voice, and I will count to three...

story_quest:Heihaian.source_en: Hi! I'm KU-Key. Tethys sent me to assist you!
Welcome to the Haven of Sprouts, where Black Shores members live and rest. The anchor here is our communication hub, linking all beacons worldwide.

uncertain:Guide.source_en: Excuse me, {PlayerName}. A moment of your time, please.
We're running a new testing phase for the research project you previously participated. Are you interested in joining us again?

story_quest:EVENT.source_en: But Ragunna doesn't even have that population.
That's 3 copies each Ragunnesi? I doubt they sell as much pizza over there...

story_quest:ZXZTC.source_en: As the tides receded, a new world and an unexplored adventure awaited you.
Yangyang and Chixia found you unconscious at the Gorges of Spirits. Together, you decided to head to Huanglong's Jinzhou City, marking the beginning of your journey.

Jinzhou, a border city in Huanglong, had long been a battleground against the Threnodian Ovathrax. The Midnight Rangers, led by General Jiyan, fought tirelessly against the waves of Tacet Discords—nightmarish entities created by the Threnodian—near the Norfall Barrens...

story_quest:HD.source_en: Darkness gradually dissolves as faint light shines over the crimson carpet. You find yourself standing in a corridor lined with an array of posters. This must be where the Somnoire Film Festival is being held.
"From what I can tell, we're at this Film Festival inside of the Somnoire. But why are you up, Abby?"

story_quest:DDTSYZL.source_en: Looks like these pages are from an Acolyte's memoir. She used to serve at the Titular Repository in Avinoleum.
Avinoleum... That was the name of the old Seminary in Ragunna, wasn't it? Once a place of great renown.
Yes, it's been a long time since its heyday. This book tells about her life there. Nothing too dramatic.

story_quest:SIDE.source_en: I've done a search of the area. Nothing out of the ordinary.
These rails however... They seem to have been built by the Fractsidus. In my previous visit I found out that I could slide along them.

story_quest:ATYDZH.source_en: It must be one of Phrolova's tricks.
Whatever she's planning, I'd better run a proper investigation first.
The frequency was shattered and remade by the crashing tide. What they call immortality is nothing but a fragile masquerade.

story_quest:MAIN.source_en: (Covered in Tidal Blight... it has even fused into the joints. I'll need to clear this if I want to get it moving.)
(To protect these waters, the stewards must've set up a platform with Gladiator spears nearby.)
(I'll activate the patrol unit, then grab a spear from the platform to clear out this Blight.)

uncertain:qqbxd.source_en: I will not lose to some prophecy. I will not...

story_quest:CDFZYD.source_en: Extreme sports enthusiasts wanted—With good rewards!
Hello, hello. Can I interest you in doing the Wildland Eight?

uncertain:llbhy.source_en: (Through the light veil of destiny, I saw a battlefield. There was no smoke in the air, no sound of war drums, no brothers or sisters in arms. This individual will face an unbeatable adversary alone in the twilight of his life...)
(Aeolus, his eyes burning with desires for glory, but the future revealed by fate is far from what he envisions. He will die in obscurity.)

story_quest:STNPC.source_en: What is the meaning of this affront to the Deep Dwellers' altar...?
The phantom vanishes the moment your hand comes close to it.

story_quest:GNNPC.source_en: Mm… careful! I smell a powerful frequency.
...Is it coming from the top of the Crest? Let's check it out.

Of the Three Heroes' Crest, beyond the legendary exploits of its Heroes of Heroes, there is another story seldom told.

A young Gladiator once climbed the summit alone after a hunt under the cover of night. When he returned to camp, his fellows were astonished, for this "Dragon Slayer" bore upon his body more than a hundred wounds, great and small. He had clearly endured a harrowing battle, a trial beyond imagining.

The Gladiator smiled wryly, admitting his defeat. Many would remember it as the "Flawless Hero's" first failure. His second, the tragedy of Fabianum, would follow not long after.

That Gladiator was Magno, the former Ephor of Septimont.

story_quest:Shixifeidu.source_en: The Tethys System recently expanded its frequency feature library and detected a previously unknown, special frequency. In response, the Black Shores dispatched Bloom Bearers to investigate. Valentina informs you that Shorekeeper is now analyzing the abnormal frequency and suggests you meet her for more information.
Group A, begin data preprocessing. Group B, deploy ground interference neutralizers... Oh, {PlayerName}, you're here.
Why is there such a large gathering today?

story_quest:HHAXST.source_en: Ah... finally a break. I can't even remember the last time I got to enjoy something KU-Cook made.
KU-Cook's still going strong. Right now it's scolding someone for uploading bizarre recipes again.
This is the kind of peace we've all been longing for.

story_quest:Main.source_en: I think we've been spotted... Or maybe it's just paranoia.
Either way, we must stay on our toes.
Steady. The alarm's moments from triggering.

story_quest:LNXTSXYD.source_en: So, even Rinascita has Sonance Caskets, huh?
I wonder if someone here would buy them, like Uncle Chenpi back in Jinzhou.
We should keep an eye out!

story_quest:WDSXD.source_en: I'd still be dozing out in the wild if it weren't for your help.

story_quest:CJBOC.source_en: Oh, aren't those the cute little Plushies from the village? Nice composition, and the shot really makes the most of the scenery!
You really captured them in action during their adventure. Have you ever thought about doing some part-time photography for us?
{PlayerName} didn't take this picture. Anyway, the Plushies got super moody when they saw it. Any idea why?

story_quest:YYYHZG.source_en: Great Sentinel above, can you hear me?
Please guide me out of this treacherous land!

story_quest:RGZYYYGJZ.source_en: These flashbacks... Could it be from touching that mirror? Energy crystals made into a mirror, with a pre-made Sonoro inside... Hmm, a sly trap.
This Sonoro, the docks, Benett's Terminal, Duncan... When did it all begin?
And the hand that pulled me in... I need to get to the bottom of this, and quickly.

story_quest:HHYSTBC.source_en: Xin chào bạn, bạn có thích bản sao của Sứa trong đêm ma quái không?
Nothing pairs better with a chilling tale than a cup of our finest Blood Coffee.
Oh, no thanks… This place already gives me enough chills as it is.

story_quest:ZX.source_en: You sneak up behind this peeping Nimbus Wraith, and it doesn't seem to notice you.
It makes gestures and mumbles words you can't understand.

uncertain:Guid.source_en: The tower... It seems to have risen to where Avinoleum is.
What happened? Was that my hallucination?
The clamor of the crowd, their panicked shrieks, and an eerie hymn echo all around...

uncertain:FlowEditor.source_en: Pizza Classica, Pizza Tropicale, or Laurus Salad required

story_quest:BBTTC.source_en: Remember the TD simulation data surge at the TD Observatory? If we leave it unchecked, it could lead to contamination.
That's why we run simulations like this—to prevent such outcomes. But remember, the abnormal data in Virtual Crisis can affect you as well.
Think of this as your warm-up. I believe in you! After all, you're the most dependable elite Bloom Bearer in the entire Black Shores!

story_quest:QQSXYD.source_en: Ah, {PlayerName}. I heard you've made it to Septimont.
Mind visiting these coordinates I just sent you when you have the time?
Got a few little ones there waiting for you!

story_quest:BVBHD.source_en: Black hair, golden eyes, an outlander's clothing, and a Tacet Mark on your hand...

story_quest:XJZM.source_en: Maybe I should go look for him, Captain.
Just wait. He usually comes back around this time.

uncertain:lmzx.source_en: How are the rebuilding efforts going, Phoebe?
O lost souls adrift in surging tides, may your frequencies find peace. May my prayers accompany you back to the high heavens.
Acolyte Phoebe, can our prayers really reach those devoured by the Dark Tide? Or will they also...

uncertain:lmzxst.source_en: Acolyte Pheobe has been awfully busy lately.
Can't be helped. Barlin and Gnessa martyred themselves, and the Fabricatorium is a make or break for the entire Common Echo system, so Acolyte Luther has to be there in person.
And Priest Alessio runs off at a time like this? Unbelievable.

story_quest:HRT.source_en: 'Twas a battle fierce and dire. The Laureate fell, consumed by mire.
Into the Dark Tide {Male=he's;Female=she's} gone, vanished. Our minds shattered, hope now banished
O' woeful hearts! O' helpless hands! Was this the end of all our plans?

story_quest:SZSTBC.source_en: Oh… This… Huh? Why am I here?

story_quest:CD.source_en: Mom hasn't been home in a long time...
I really want to go out and look for her, but...
You look at frail little Misha. A gust of wind could knock her over.

story_quest:SDLZXXBST.source_en: During the peak dining hours, seat turnover rises by 37%, yet the average meal time falls by 15%. Such herd behavior is worth chronicling.
Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?

uncertain:StJJDL.source_en: Once I'm done with these last few deliveries, I'll be leaving Lahai-Roi.
Why the sudden departure... Are you heading back home to get married or something?
You scared me half to death. Even if there aren't any Voidworms around, you still can't be running all the way out here.

uncertain:StHLMYD.source_en: I didn't know the Outcasts would do something that awful... If I'd known sooner, I—

story_quest:XJXYDTK.source_en: Reinar, are we really doing this...? Right here, right now?
That's right... We've only got one shot...

story_quest:XJXYBGSST.source_en: VR gaming as a way to regulate Resonator frequencies? Not a bad idea.
But I can't even play a decent game of gomoku. Are you sure you want me as a consultant?
You're the foremost expert on Resonance awareness manipulation. We really need you!

story_quest:XJXYSDJ.source_en: We're rushing production on the new batch of uniforms. Please wait for the Academy's official notice.
Jasper, oh Jasper… you can't keep gaming like this. Just one more game, then I'll hit the books...
…Damn it! So close to breaking the record! One more!

story_quest:XJXYSHQTYST.source_en: Fellow student, care to join our club activities? We have publication-worthy research topics!
I'm almost late for class... Next time, I promise!
I haven't eaten in three days... must keep going...

story_quest:XJXYSSFBST.source_en: Whoa, is this our dormitory? All the students crammed into one building?
The Academy's official website says every student has a private room here, but… I guess it won't be very spacious.
Relax. It's bigger on the inside. You'll see for yourself.

story_quest:MJWB.source_en: Scanning, please wait... Sorry, access denied.
Conference Hall is closed when not in use for thesis defenses, forums, or conferences.

story_quest:RLSJWF.source_en: Found more Soliskin... I should get back to Soliseed Plains and tell Lyosroth when I have the time.
(Contacting) Sorry to bother you, {PlayerName}, but would you mind coming to the Soliseed Plains?
(Contacting) We are terribly short-handed on Shepherds here in Bjartr Woods at the moment. We could really use your help...

story_quest:XJXYST.source_en: Engineering wrecked the testing ground floor again? Are they trying to launch themselves to the moon?
At least no one was hurt this time. Just let it go...
Breathe, deep breaths... This is not a dream. I really landed that internship at the Research Institute!

story_quest:XJXYBC.source_en: Treat the Mechascout as an extension of your own body and senses...
Remember that feeling... Reach the pinnacle of human–machine unity...
This Flora Reindeer has been acknowledged as the "leader" by the rest of the herd.

uncertain:GuideXJJSS.source_en: Students of Startorch Academy, the new season of the Startorch Race is about to begin!
Tracks with more dynamic designs, more thrilling challenges, and even richer rewards are all waiting for you!
Hop on your motorbike, head for the track, feel the thrill of the rush, and push the very limits of speed!

uncertain:StXYHYDX.source_en: Welcome, {PlayerName}. Your information has been processed and temporary access has been granted.  Welcome to Startorch Academy!

The Academy was founded with the core mission of identifying and training Synchronists capable of piloting the Exostrider, while cultivating expertise across all related fields. It functions as an integrated, non-profit base for both education and advanced research.
As the stars of knowledge brighten the sky, let Startorch Academy be the torch that lights the way for every curious mind.

story_quest:BYST.source_en: There really is a forest in the frostlands!
And it's more than that. All the plants you see here are living fossils!
This is incredible. There really is a forest in the frostlands!

story_quest:KKZKJZST.source_en: You like Snowfluff Seals? Uh... well, good for you.
What do you mean? Don't you find them ridiculously soft and adorable?!
Just wait until you see those razor-sharp teeth in their gaping mouths…

story_quest:BYCZ.source_en: Connection! That's what we're all about!
...Safety inspection's done on this one. Move along.
Yes? Who are you? I don't recognize you.

story_quest:BYYSG.source_en: All right, sign here... Yep, right there.
Newcomers coming in every year... wrestling with the frostlands. Where does it end?

story_quest:BYSTMP.source_en: Most Startorch students only get to see the frostlands' snow twice in their lives.
When they first arrive at the harbor by ship, and finally when they leave the Academy. The first meeting… and the last farewell.
Oh, come on. Stop blubbing like a Blubbin Puffin. You've got plenty more chances to see this snow until you're sick of it!

story_quest:RLJQTS.source_en: You found more Soliskin... When you have time, look for the Giant Soliskin.

story_quest:HRQDGNQST.source_en: Welcome to the Psychological Threshold Alternative Therapy Society!
We just rolled out a new immersive therapy game, and would like to invite everyone to come experience it!
My alma mater! Let me soak in this ceremonial atmosphere just a little longer...

story_quest:QDHDNPCST.source_en: Have you left already? I was gonna ask you to bring a Soliskin plushie for pics.
I found one already, though... Wait, you're still in the dorm?! Get outta bed!
Bring something? Nah, don't bother with the plushie. Just get your butt over here!

story_quest:LHYSTTH2.source_en: New arrivals from the Coffee Society! Special Voidworm Rider edition. Get your free sample—
Olive Meteorite Latte! Frostwort Edelccino! And savory "Foxtail Kelp Ocean Brew" with a dash of sea salt!

story_quest:ST.source_en: Look, the Ancient Voidbane Tree! After all our hard work, it's finally a real tree now!
People at the Institute say this kind of tree could date back to ancient times.
Actually, ever since we arrived in Lahai-Roi, we've been running into all kinds of "old things"...

story_quest:AYJJST.source_en: Please, Professor. Can you go over it again? I'll pay attention this time, I promise!
I really don't wanna mess up and be cursed by Shepherds with their Royan runes!!!
Oh, Barnaby.  If you'd paid attention in my lectures, you'd know that's a hoax.

story_quest:ZSPYMP.source_en: An entirely new adaptive pathway for ancient flora… This is it. The real frontier in life sciences.
This level of innovation could land me a publication before I even graduate!
Miss Effye, is it true that the Shepherds are bringing a group of Soliskin here?

story_quest:LHYSTTHZB.source_en: Chin up! Chest out! Where's your fire?!
You're a Synchronist, aren't you? What's with this sniveling?
B-but what's going to happen to Rabelle College...?

story_quest:LHYSTTH.source_en: We owe the finished Drive Replica to Professor Mornye. Her early analysis was what laid the path.
…I swear, you treat NDAs like suggestions. Please, not here.
Never thought those Research Institute folks who can't even do five-digit mental math would awaken the Exostrider!

story_quest:SideCSYH.source_en: Hello, student! Ready to take on the unbeatable track of doom?
Wait. The road behind the starting line in the video is different from the actual track.
The track's data is manually controlled. A discrepancy like this shouldn't happen. This may be the breakthrough I'm looking for.

uncertain:GuidePLJJC.source_en: {PlayerName}, you need clearance before you can boot up the Route Constructor. And you're in luck, the person in charge of the route network is right over there working maintenance on it.
His name is Chonglin. Go talk to him, he'll update your clearance and show you how to use the Route Constructor.
Once you've gained access, you can start rebuilding the route network. That'll be a huge help to the Spacetrek Observatory, and it'll make getting around Lahai-Roi much easier for you as well.

story_quest:TWTPOI.source_en: Nice to meet you, {PlayerName}! I'm KU-Raji, and I'll be supporting your work in Lahai-Roi from the Black Shores.
Alright! Let's get to it. There's a giant facility built in the mysterious and rather dangerous land of Lahai-Roi—the Spacetrek Observatory.
The Spacetrek Collective once used it to observe and record everything happening in the region. But a Void Storm struck years ago and left it in ruins. Repairs have been... slow, to say the least.

story_quest:TWTPOIZX.source_en: (Hmm, definitely the work of an Outcast.)

story_quest:CBYD.source_en: The Voidmatters Meteorological Bureau has issued a Void Storm Alert.
Void Storms are expected in seven locations during the current storm period.
All students are advised to avoid these areas and take appropriate precautionary measures.

story_quest:PYDML.source_en: Please, Miss Zahira… d-don't tease me like that…
That "Startorch's Seven Great Mysteries" and "Mindbending Herder" stuff… t-they're just rumors… right?
(Zahira gives a sly blink, her hands still moving without the slightest intention of stopping.)

story_quest:SLDYS.source_en: "I remember it now… the climax of this Melody. The sound of Mi is green, the same green as sprouting branches, breathing mountain forests, fresh young leaves…"

uncertain:StMTJX.source_en: Detected. You are now leaving Startorch Academy. To navigate the vast and boundless Lahai-Roi wilderness, temporary vehicle access has been granted.

Sending you the coordinates of the Vehicle Training Terminal. Please operate a vehicle after thoroughly learning the vehicle operating guidelines and familiarizing yourself with the Traffic Safety Regulations.
Any modification data applied to your temporary vehicle will be automatically transferred once you obtain a permanent vehicle.

story_quest:DCTZ.source_en: {PlayerName}, we've detected a severe traffic congestion.
If you have a minute, please help direct traffic at the location in accordance with the Startorch Traffic Safety Regulations.
The Academy will distribute General Motor Vehicle Training Studies credits and rewards based on your performance.

story_quest:GFKYD.source_en: {PlayerName}, the Academy has detected that you've performed a circuit breaker reset of a Smartprint Cube.
If these small printing machines are severely impacted by a Void Storm, surface Cube Blockers will be deployed automatically to prevent overload.
Some breakers suffering minor impact are able to recover on their own after the Void Storm subsides. Any serious influence will require a manual reset.

uncertain:Kouweigailiang.source_en: Feels like I ate something, and yet ate nothing at all...

story_quest:GFKTZ.source_en: {PlayerName}, is that you? I can't believe you came to Lahai-Roi!
Mr. Fulmine from Ragunna mentioned you in a postcard he sent me.
Unlike the many splendours of Ragunna, the Lahai-Roi wilderness has an untamed beauty to it.

story_quest:ZYFZDDDA.source_en: But that's okay—sometimes even the whole world moves slowly.
Or... You could try clapping to a beat.

story_quest:SideLLZX.source_en: Outcast groups sighted near the northern section of the Orbit Valley Pass. Highway security has been compromised. Please take an alternative route.
Who are you? How did you find this place?
You're the one who stopped the last carjacking too! So... we have a traitor!

story_quest:BGYDGDSJ.source_en:
OPEN CALL: The "Light Chaser Collection" is now accepting submissions!
Startorch Academy's Photography Fan Club, Lightborne Horizons, is looking for students who can capture the little wonders of campus life.
Whether you're new to the Academy or a returning student hoping to preserve your memories, we invite everyone who loves chasing light and shadow to help us record the brightest moments of our youth.
Sign-up Location: Spacetrek Archive, daily from 12:00–14:00.

OPEN CALL: The "Light Chaser Collection" is now accepting submissions!
Startorch Academy's Photography Fan Club, Lightborne Horizons, is looking for students who can capture the little wonders of campus life.
Whether you're new to the Academy or a returning student hoping to preserve your memories, we invite everyone who loves chasing light and shadow to help us record the brightest moments of our youth.
Sign-up Location: Spacetrek Archive, daily from 12:00–14:00.

uncertain:Kanxingxing.source_en: I'm near the Spacetrek Observatory. Please help me...
You're back. Um... got any news about Sanna?

story_quest:WYGTDSZZ.source_en: ...So, you've heard the story too, huh?
Stop, stop! Just drop it! I'm seriously freaking out!
The night hangs heavy. Distant streetlamps flicker on and off like an eye fighting to stay awake.

story_quest:BYZF.source_en: These are the packages for today.
I got this. I've been doing this for years. Still worried I can't handle myself?

story_quest:XYBKSY.source_en: You receive a message from an unknown sender.
The forbidden stories, the unexplainable phenomena... the stuff of campus legend. Ever heard 'em?

story_quest:ZHDGT.source_en: You receive a message from the Paranormal Fan Club.
Hello. Please don't be alarmed by this unexpected message.
Mayo? Finally changed your username, huh?

story_quest:MSZWZSD.source_en: You about done? If you're finishing up, just clock out early.
This tunnel has been off lately...

story_quest:ZLXYBLZ.source_en: Night falls. Red lights flicker through a curtain of rain, carrying the damp, metallic smell of iron and dirt.
What is that sound? Some kind of banging...

story_quest:SXHCDLC.source_en: …{PlayerName}? Ahh, there we go! Signal's clear now!
Mayo, do you know what time it is?
Uh... pushing midnight? Why? What's up?

story_quest:WFLKDJS.source_en: Hellooo, {PlayerName}…? You around Rabelle College right now?
How do you know that? Are you actually psychic?

story_quest:SidePLJCD.source_en: Should I head back to the Academy to find someone who can ride a motorbike? Or...
Should I head back to the Academy to find someone who can ride a motorbike? Or...

story_quest:GCWF.source_en: Arrived at base. Commencing mop cycle——
Oh, so now you're a floor cleaner?! Nice try, but you're not getting out of cargo duty that easy!

story_quest:MSRLWF.source_en: Is that a Soliskin over there?
It's that timid Soliskin again! Wait, what's it doing up on the cliff?

story_quest:FDRLWF.source_en: The detector shows the supplies are here.... So where are they?
Next time, get someone to comb the place. Top to bottom!

story_quest:LZXBSC.source_en: These things again… Where are they all coming from?
*Sigh* I just finished cleaning this place up yesterday…

story_quest:GLXXDDD.source_en: Okay, let me spell it out for you—
The system says your order's ready. I don't want to know why your taste in food is the way it is, but can you please stop ordering weird stuff if you're not gonna pick it up?!
You order, you pay. That's how business works.

story_quest:AYJJZS.source_en: {PlayerName}, look! There's a Soliskin right on the edge of that cliff!
It's not about to jump, is it?
A blanket, with many names stitched carefully along a hidden seam. It was likely swept here by the Void Storm.

story_quest:AYJJWD.source_en: Hello, {PlayerName}. This is Linnea. I learned just now that Babu, Barton, Bada, and Banana all received your help. My thanks, I cannot give enough.
That gardener story I told you before... You know, don't you? I feel that I am that very gardener.
A plan I have made. With someone I trust, I wish to share it. Have you time? To come by the Base Camp?

story_quest:AYJJSD.source_en: {PlayerName}, what are you up to? Busy? If you've got a sec, you should swing by the Dimmr Plains.
It's the closest sector to the Stridergate, so the Threnodian markers took a while to drop to safety thresholds. Now the Academy is officially greenlighting the Lumen Initiative.
Thing is, a lot of the faculty are still recovering after the last battle. We're short-staffed, you know how it is. But the Dimmr Plains does have fascinating ecology. So, can I tempt you to join?

uncertain:zhixian.source_en: To all researchers and students involved in Dimmr Plains operations:
In response to the lingering Voidmatter threat and to support various field research needs—
The Special Response Force has prepared a batch of "Origami Constructs." Once you enter the Dimmr Plains, they will automatically follow and assist you.

story_quest:FGGQDJX.source_en: HELP! HELP! Is this the rescue team? I'm trapped on a branch over the western cliffs near the station. The wind is crazy and I'm freezing my butt off.
Please send someone to get me down… and keep this a secret mission. Don't let anyone know.
Hello? Hey? Anyone there? …You guys still taking jobs?

story_quest:SXNPCXS.source_en: I appreciate your assistance, bearer of an identical frequency.
The Voidmatter contamination within this body has finally reached the limit of my structural integrity.
When this day ends, so too shall my mission.

story_quest:XLLH.source_en: These traces were left by a certain miko. Touch them, steady your mind, and the lingering frequency will clear any threats nearby.
Is this a frequency Hiyuki left?

story_quest:AYRLSJWFBC.source_en: The terrain of the Dimmr Plains is difficult, and several areas are still contaminated by Voidmatter.
I've done my best to guide the Soliskin, but with so few Shepherds, many are still scattered across the Plains.
If you happen to come across any lost Soliskin, could you tell them to find me here?

story_quest:zhuiyuejie.source_en: How've you been? Is life in Jinzhou treating you well? You know I'm here if you ever need anything.
Oh, Yangyang! What's there to be shy about? If you want to see {PlayerName}, just tell {Male=him;Female=her}!

uncertain:GuideLZDG02.source_en: Honored guest from afar, I am relieved to finally see you.
I'm afraid it's not right to burden you with such a troublesome matter, but I can't think of anyone else capable of handling it.

story_quest:DYHD.source_en: Ah, call me Ishmael. Well, well! The Laureate, I presume? Have you ever tried fishing before?
The trick to it is a flexible line and a subtle lure.
Fancy trying your hand at deep sea fishing? It's one of Rinascita's many lasting traditions, like the Carnevale.

story_quest:YZJPQH.source_en: So, are you ready for an exciting and thrilling game of "Stellar Orbit Beats"?

uncertain:EventGXX.source_en: Thank you for contributing to the reconstruction of the Observatory-Academy Highway!

This route will once again carry a steady flow of supplies and talent to the Spacetrek Observatory. Startorch Academy's long-stalled field studies of the Giant's Gaze will also resume thanks to this vital connection.
The Spacetrek Collective will forever honor your service!

uncertain:GuideLZDG03.source_en: Hello there, fellow student. Welcome to the Academy's virtual training platform. Interested to know more?

uncertain:EventTQDX.source_en: Look, Mentor, the rain and Helios's light are woven together.
Photo: Starward Riseway in a sunshower.
Beyond Lahai-Roi, you sometimes get sunshowers like this. The reason being...

story_quest:PQGCST.source_en: (Here goes nothing. I need to confess to Alma on the cable car. Today! But... will I have the guts to say it?)
I can't stand these foreign hawkers clogging up our streets.
They're loud. They're rude. And they're willing to sell anything to tourists for a quick buck.

story_quest:XCLST.source_en: I took part in another practice match but lost in the final round this week. I'll sign up for the real thing once I can win three rounds in a row.
Ah, Septimont! Where strength reigns supreme. Everything here feels different than back home.

story_quest:ZDFST.source_en: Those able to serve in the Ephor's Palace are undoubtedly the best of the best. It's only natural for them to face stricter trials.
The delicate balance between the Ephor, the nobles, and ourselves requires utmost attention. Next, I'll be going through the specifics—
Finally got a placement in the housing lottery. I knew the paperwork would be a hassle, but I still didn't expect it to drag on this long.

story_quest:FWNPC.source_en: Wow, this bathhouse is really impressive...
Well? See that? That's the fortress city of Septimont.

story_quest:GKST.source_en: Can I bring these in? Yes? Maybe? No?
Ugh, I don't think I can.

story_quest:POIXLXJQR.source_en: Systems Activating... Performing Onboard Analysis... Alert: Leg Components, Not Found. Main Motor Module, Diagnostic... Requesting Shutdown...
Dang it, still not working. HQ, this is Rabbit 2, over. Rabbit 2 to HQ, do you copy? Over...
Rabbit 2 here, I've attempted multiple radio contacts with HQ and received zero response so far... All I can hear out here is Blu checking itself over and over again, and... the wind.

uncertain:GuideDJTP.source_en: The system has recognized that you have embarked on a unique journey, with your own companions and narrative.
As previously instructed, I will set up a test for you in the Jinzhou wilderness.

story_quest:Huanglong.source_en: A hidden passage... As I expected.
That must be the entrance to the Database.
A part of the building is submerged... I should be able to find the hidden path underwater.

story_quest:TZZNQ.source_en: Hiya! It's been a while. Encore and the people at the Pioneer Association have made something super cool!
They need someone to try it out, and I think you'd be just perfect! We should play it together!
It's gonna be soooo much fun! Encore can't wait to see you!

story_quest:AYJJGNDB.source_en: Hey there, {PlayerName}. How may I assist you today? Looking for a literature review, some specific data... or did you just stop by to spend a little time with me?
Oh, so you've gathered more Prism Fruits. I truly appreciate your dedication to the collection.
Hmm... No Prism Fruits? Don't forget to bring some with you next time, {PlayerName}!

story_quest:XJXYSSQTST.source_en: Finally, the project's done! Sweet, sweet freedom! Vacation, here I come!
Check out my greatest pics from break... forwarding this masterpiece to Revan. Let's mark it "urgent."
Urgent? Seriously? Doesn't your conscience sting a little?

story_quest:XDQY.source_en: Upon coming to your senses, a soft hue blurs your vision.
As the mist clears, you find yourself standing in a place you know by heart—a landscape of winding rivers and jagged peaks woven beneath the clouds.

It is a perfect replica of Jinzhou. Every street, every narrow alley, the curve of every roof ridge, and the flow of every waterway has been recreated with precision. Even the whisper of the wind against your ears sounds exactly as it should.

story_quest:LGNCZST.source_en: ...Lollo Logistics' motto is "We Promise, We Deliver!"
No matter where, we'll be at your service, fully committed to guarding your parcels!
Hey, have you heard of the Fool's Troupe that sails across the sea? Haha, well, that's us!

story_quest:LGNCZSTBC.source_en: We're back in Ragunna again—the same old streets, the same old scenery... How boring.
Agreed. Only after visiting Riccioli Islands can one truly feel the world's vibrancy.
Then there's Lilyland Fashion Week, and the heart-pounding battles of Septimont...

uncertain:StZLCZ.source_en: Just ask if you need assistance using the station facilities. I am here to help.
On a field expedition, safety comes first. Everyone open your internship handbooks. I'll keep this brief.

uncertain:StTWT.source_en: Not enough supplies and manpower. How should I start...
Right. I should find Rakosan. He'll know what to do.
Recoder or Reformer, or whatever they're called? I just can't stand people who think they're above everyone else.

uncertain:Motorcycle.source_en: All systems, check. Engine parameters, check.... Off we go. Just like in Honami.
At times like this, it's hard to keep my eyes on the road. They keep drifting toward the horizon.
Ugh... I really don't look forward to fixing my hair later.

uncertain:GuideLZDG.source_en: When you are exploring outside, have you seen some pedestals with strange projections?

uncertain:HuanglongXZ.source_en: That was close! You fought so well!
Hehe... Oh, by the way, speaking of Baizhi!

story_quest:HSGD.source_en: Do you know why there are names engraved on the abandoned turrets here?

uncertain:HuanglongM1.source_en: Alrighty. What should we do next?
Shall we go grab a bite?

story_quest:POIWGZSDXX.source_en: This is so exhausting. Another overtime session... I want to go home.
Why are they still not here...

story_quest:POIWGZSDXD.source_en: Hm hm. It's a small, small box and a big, big world. It's a big, big world and a small, small box.
The world is the nutshell of a box, while the box is in the world of endless possibilities...
Hey hey. The world in the box is the best, and the best world is the box...

uncertain:zhaidishengtai.source_en: It has been some time, honored guest.
Do you have an interest in our morning prayer as well?
You aren't from the Order, are you?

story_quest:TBNPCJHTB.source_en: Hi there, I'm the temporary assistant here at the infirmary.
Why am I in Zahira's spot? She's just taking five and was kind enough to let me set up here.
Knowing her, there are only two reasons she'd step away.

story_quest:GNNPCXJXY.source_en: Ran into a snag? Go ahead and ask me… Oh! Wait, didn't I literally just pull up that entry?
Oh, {PlayerName}. Take a seat. Are you experiencing sleep deprivation?

uncertain:EventJJSPH.source_en:
Sabercat Reavers are no kidding. Real top predators. Super speedy. But they still ate my dust!
PS: For professionals seeking ideas for racetrack designs only. DO NOT ATTEMPT.
Huafeng
Should I go get a Geospider? But the Relay Station needs to get the power on right now...
Should I go get a Geospider? But the Relay Station needs to get the power on right now...

story_quest:SLZYDST.source_en: You... I didn't raise you to be so defiant!
With all due respect, Uncle, we live in a new age now.
That's enough, Martina. Just save it!

story_quest:HHAPKHD.source_en: You know that data overflow incident, right? I just got some fascinating ideas from it! The embodied data can be used to create fun stuff as well!
For example... an Overdashing Challenge unique to the Black Shores, inspired by Jinzhou's Overdash Club! Care to give it a try?

story_quest:HHABJCSM.source_en: Good news! The Sonoros lingering in the Black Shores can now be used as portals to access the Modulation Hall!

story_quest:YYSRZFDXFB.source_en: You receive a message from Yangyang.

story_quest:YYSRZFDX.source_en: You receive a message from Yangyang.

story_quest:QX.source_en: For my thesis acknowledgments, I'll include my advisor, my parents, and {PlayerName}.

uncertain:katixiya-shengtai.source_en: You've come to this Sonoro Sphere once again. What is it this time?
On a request? Procurement of a rare plant species...? To remember the past?
What if I didn't need a reason?

uncertain:jiabeilina.source_en: Farewell, ever-awake hunter. May our paths grant our wishes.

uncertain:ktll.source_en: With peace returning to Ragunna, I've finally found time to explore the city.
Taking one's time to choose an afternoon tea like this... is quite delightful.

uncertain:Augusta.source_en: That stride... Hah. As I thought. Among all I know, only one moves with such unique composure.

uncertain:younuo.source_en: We meet again, Unwritten... Hmm, yes. Unwritten.
So? Did you come all this way just to gaze at the moon, or to steal a glimpse at Septimont's most brilliant Priestess... me?
You always seem to follow the moonlight.

uncertain:Iuno.source_en: I know I've told you what makes this place special. I even shared the moonlight with you... but visiting this often? It's a little...
Don't tell me you just like staring at the moon?

uncertain:chun.source_en: After we dealt with that troublemaking Stellar Matrix…

story_quest:LKKST.source_en: Tornado maker, dimension-warping lamp, fireworks pistol...
Script, ready. Lights, ready. Music, ready...
So… what shall we put on tonight?

story_quest:AMS31.source_en: You look toward "Aemeath." She is quietly resting on the sofa, eyes closed.

story_quest:SHENGTAI.source_en: Hehehe, look who's here... Now be good. Pats incoming!
You see Aemeath crouching near some Snowfluff Seals. Her smile is soft as she reaches out to ruffle the fur on one of their heads.
The Snowfluff Seals look dazed, their eyes squinted as they remain still, as if knowing resistance is futile by Aemeath's aura alone.

uncertain:kamola.source_en: In Ragunna, there's never a shortage of secluded corners untouched by the masses. Yet somehow, you found me here. What a...
I had a gut feeling I'd find you here.

story_quest:XGLK.source_en: Yes, yes... No, I promised I wouldn't overdo it this time. Really!
I've been trying to say no to requests I can't handle. I'm fine. Don't worry, okay?
Yes, I'll keep in touch—Ah, my friend is here. I'll talk to you later, Mother. Okay, bye-bye.

uncertain:Luuk.source_en: {PlayerName}? What a rare guest. Are you just stopping by... or did you come seeking an old friend?

uncertain:ActivityRoleTrial.source_en: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!
Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.

story_quest:GondolaRideSharingPlot.source_en: This feels different from Phaom... Hmm, why are you laughing? N-not that incident again! Stop making me embarrassed!
The chains have vanished. This is no longer the battlefield I once fought for my life, nor the shackle that once bound me. It is now... a peaceful landscape.
This is the small town where I spent my childhood. Much has changed, but many places still retain their original charm. You've seen the graffiti, haven't you?

uncertain:EventCLFY.source_en: Watch out! Stay clear of the way! It's dangerous!
A student on the road at this hour? Are you here for field work?
Phew... Thanks to Spacetrek Collective's built-in precaution & auto-braking system on this vehicle. That was a close one.

story_quest:JKXCCZST.source_en: This is a restricted area. Entry by unauthorized personnel is forbidden.
Patrol of Section 2 complete. No anomalies were detected.
Ah, Ragunna... I miss the noise and bustle of the city. And the blue skies, not this ceiling overhead...

story_quest:DYHDST.source_en: Are you curious about this old ship too? Hmm, seems like I'm not the only one who thinks there's something wrong with it.
See, we've always fished close to shore, that's why we Riccioli fishermen use Gondolas when we head out.
But word is, years ago Captain Ahab and his crew pulled out a wreck of a ship outta the sea, then left it with a strange fella to guard it.

story_quest:HHACZST.source_en: I've never seen a plant rooted in the Tacetite before.
Ku—Plants that grow on the Tacetite will slowly lose their pigmentation until they turn purple or white.
No matter what you do, you can't find plants in any other colors here.

Press {0}/{1} in the air to trigger <color=#ffd12f>backflip</color>.

story_quest:AdvertisingRegion.source_en: A warm, humid haven beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift, this region became the new Solaris pole, prompting the Roya to migrate below ground. Here, the Spacetrek Collective established Startorch Academy. Today, this borderless academic city has become a cradle for countless rising scholars.

Officially Spacetrek Collective: Startorch Academy, it stands as a borderless scientific community dedicated to the pure pursuit of knowledge. Its name reflects its ethos, "to carry the flame of inquiry and ignite the torch of civilization." Within this vast academic city, knowledge flows freely and cultures meet in harmony.

A grand observational array established by Startorch Academy. Unlike the Cassettes, which record humanity, this system was built to record Lahai-Roi. It continuously tracks terrain shifts, ecological cycles, and celestial disturbances wrought by Void Storms and the Threnodian, like a giant eye observing the turning of the ages.

A new battle mechanic has been added when Resonators battle enemies: Off-Tune Mechanic.

Off-Tune and Mistune

Your Resonators' attacks build up enemies' Off-Tune Level. Once the enemy's Off-Tune Level reaches the limit, they enter the Mistune state.

During the enemy's Mistune state, your Resonators can unleash a powerful Tune Break, dealing additional damage. Landing a Tune Break resets the enemies' Off-Tune Level.
Within a period after being struck by Tune Break, the enemy's Off-Tune level cannot be built up again.

Tune Break

For powerful enemies, once their Off-Tune Level is full, Resonators must cast a Tune Break skill to deal Tune Break damage to enemies in the Mistune State.

Tune Break skills deal damage to enemies, reduce their Vibration Strength, interrupt their attack patterns, and reset their Off-Tune Level.

story_quest:FavorGoods.source_en:
Before leaving the temple, Sanhua received a string of Mala beads from the abbot.
These precious beads hold the blessing and guidance of the abbot, serving as a constant reminder for Sanhua. In times of turmoil, she finds comfort in running her fingers over the smooth beads, using them as a meditative tool to recite the Heart Sutra and bring peace to her mind.

Jinhsi wanted to see the world through Sanhua's eyes, so Sanhua sought the guidance of a famous shadow play master in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> to show Jinhsi a glimpse of the hellish sight she witnessed. But this bizarre world unexpectedly captured Jinhsi's interest, which occasionally gave Sanhua the illusion that she could also one day live with this hell.
Unlike the rough monster shadow puppets, there is also a pair of delicate human shadow puppets that Sanhua keeps as a private collection.

Sanhua used to believe that transience was the root of all beauty in the world. Just like snow and ice, so pure and captivating, but destined to melt. But sometimes, as she holds a frozen flower in her hand, she wonders - is she admiring its fleeting beauty or mourning its inevitable demise? She freezes the frosty blossom, determined to preserve it for just a little longer. Just like this moment with all its precious memories and beauty that she vows to protect forever.

story_quest:FavorStory.source_en:
Instead of her name, Sanhua is more commonly referred to as "the <te href=850124>Magistrate's Bodyguard</te>."

Sanhua is always seen standing silently behind Jinhsi, maintaining an adequate distance. She stands tall and poised, hidden in the periphery of others' gazes, like a sharp blade ready to be unsheathed at any moment.

Although the majority of voices opposing Jinhsi have already subsided, there are still a handful of individuals who would attempt to challenge her authority. Because Jinhsi still held the title of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>'s <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, the seemingly blunt and inflexible bodyguard by her side seemed the easier target for pressure. Or so they assumed. 

Regardless of how impossible the ill-intended demands sounded, Sanhua can always flawlessly execute them to the utmost perfection. 

With her impeccable time management, sharp intellect, cool under-pressure demeanor, and savvy negotiation skills... even the harshest critics were left stunned.


As the Magistrate's bodyguard, Sanhua handles both unruly daytime guests, and those uninvited guests who lurk in the shadows.

Being Jinzhou's Magistrate, Jinhsi is a prime target with a high price on her head. Unwelcome guests sought more than just a cup of tea, but they would soon learn their mistake: instead of hot tea, they were met with the razor-sharp blade of her bodyguard. The crimson-eyed bodyguard seemed to possess an uncanny ability to detect lies. Within seconds, she transformed into a fearsome Asura ready to strike. 

One quick slash revealed shivering limbs as severed trouser legs fell in the cold air. This alone was enough to scare off most of the unwanted guests. Naturally, once the blade returned to its sheath, all shadows and shady dealings would be erased. Jinhsi's radiance would remain untainted, free from contamination.


But sometimes, even Sanhua meets surprises in life... 

"Hello. You must be Madam Magistrate's bodyguard?" 

So asked the strange resonator standing before her, who bears the same beautiful human-shaped frequency as Jinhsi.

Her world was suddenly filled with new ripples.

Sanhua's story began with the snow.

Her birthplace was destroyed by a <te href=850080>Waveworn</te> disaster, fueled by an unforgiving blizzard and the emergence of deadly <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. 

Within moments, all forms of life were crushed by the anomalous blizzard, only to be reshaped into a colossal TD standing atop the snowy mountain-turned-<te href=850078>Tacet Field</te>. The sight was both awe-inspiring and horrendous, as the entrenched TD loomed over the devastated landscape, both divine and demonic in its presence. It resembled a giant statue of the Asura.

The <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> did everything in their power to finally defeat the colossal TD. Finally, it collapsed and disintegrated in piercing roars. While cleaning the battlefield, they were shocked to find a frozen infant amidst the wreckage, her body cold and tinted blue.

The infant was still breathing faintly. 

No one could imagine how she could have survived such a cataclysm, nor did anyone have the time to ponder such thoughts. The Rangers wiped the bloodstains from their hands and carefully lifted her from the rubble. They shouted, "We found a baby! A survivor! She's alive!" 

Their excited cries echoed far beyond the frontlines, instilling courage in every soldier and spreading their love for life across the battlefield, a comforting balm for their worn-out spirits. People believed this to be "a miracle of divine favor".

Several days later, the girl rescued from the depths of hell opened her captivating odd-colored eyes for the first time. Tacet Discords did not take her life, but instead corroded her right eye. The lingering frequencies miraculously reconfigured themselves into a new eye, allowing her, who was born blind, to directly see the frequencies of all things in the world. 

— Unbeknownst to everyone back then, it was also a "Curse of the <te href=850075>Lament</te>". 
The curse distorted everything in her eyes into grotesque, eerie, and cacophonous apparitions, disturbing her senses and shattering her perception of existence in the world. She saw no lies, but neither did she ever see light. 


She relived that snowy night endlessly, struggling to escape hell only to fall back into it again, until she became an Asura herself. In a way, she was never truly rescued from that battlefield. Her world was a painting of purgatory, and she was doomed to be haunted by the Tacet Discords for the rest of her life, unable to break free.

story_quest:FavorWord.source_en: ...Ah, apologies, I got sidetracked. My eyes... They see the original frequencies of all living beings. To me, every life appears blurry and chaotic, in the shape of their souls... I knew you were special the moment I laid eyes on you. Other than my lady Jinhsi, you are the only person who looks so clear and true. I just... I haven't gotten used to the sight of you.

We are all caught in an invisible wheel of karma. We live, we die, and we live again. As time passes, some are bound to leave us behind, having reached their journey's end. All we can do is keep them in our memories and continue forward, until our end comes... What is driving you forward on your journey, Rover?

story_quest:Spring.source_en:
Magistrate Jinhsi insists that I take some time off work. The streets tonight are bustling with life. Since I have little to do, I imbibed some... floral brew. My body is warm yet my heart longs for someone to confide in.

It is a common practice to don monster masks as part of a ceremonial dance ritual. Folks here believe their reenactment of monsters from the legends of Huanglong may ward off evil and invite good fortune. As for me... I do not need the reenactment, for I have worked hard to suppress the monster within, which is already a perfect mask for me.

Those strange sights and sounds in the cold wind and snow are the past that I cannot sever. But because of you all, I see the silver lining behind these macabre scenes. You give me the strength to pray for the return of spring.

The fate you've sown will bear fruit in the coming years. Should you leave on another journey, please remember to take my... and our blessings with you.

Sanhua

This year's ceremony is different—it is the first one free of the Threnodian menace. People are finally able to laugh and rejoice from the heart, and I truly enjoy seeing everyone smile.

I've told Sanhua and Taoqi to take a break. After working all year, they deserve leisure time to bask in this hard-won warmth. When I see others happily reunited with their families, I can't help but yearn for your presence. I knew you had matters to attend to, but your absence during the most festive days in a year would have made everyone a bit lonely.

So, when you came back with guests from Rinascita, I was truly happy—you really do miss Jinzhou enough to spend time with me. Perhaps, in your heart, Jinzhou has become your home.

I wrote a song to express my gratitude, and it seems I'll finally get to sing it. Wearing the ceremonial dress still makes me a bit shy, but if you like, I'll wear it properly after I finish work and sing just for you.

Jinhsi

I hope this letter finds you well.

Jinhsi and Sanhua were overjoyed by the glowing reviews of the Hero Play from the guests of Rinascita. After a year of hard work, they can finally set aside their duties and enjoy a well-deserved respite.

Your Rinascitan friends were eager to share thrilling tales of the Laureate with me, and I found their stories about you both delightful and heartwarming. It is truly gratifying to see the profound impact your journey has had on the lives of others.

However, I believe it is time for you to take some proper rest now, after the busyness of the Hero Play and the joy of welcoming your friends. During your absence, several notable events transpired in Jinzhou. If you are interested, I would be happy to recount them to you at your leisure.

The day before your return to Jinzhou, the winter's last snowstorm breathed a delicate layer of snow on our Go checkerboard, on which I wrote a wish.

By the time you receive this letter, it will have already come true.

Changli

story_quest:AreaReportContent.source_en:
A storyteller's script based on historical events, recounting the history of the Jinzhou region in Huanglong.
 
 ...

Jinzhou, the fortress city that guards the border of Huanglong, also stands as Huanglong's first border of entry for those arriving from overseas. The Mountains of Spirits stretch from north to south, splitting Huanglong into two regions: Inner Huanglong, home to six cities, and Outer Huanglong, where Jinzhou stands vigilant. These mountains form a natural barrier, with the gorges acting as the only gateway into Inner Huanglong, protected day and night by Jinzhou's Midnight Rangers.
 
The establishment of the first fortress in Outer Huanglong began with the emergence of the Norfall Barrens Tacet Field, where TD Outbreaks began to ravage the region. After enduring months of grueling combat, the army could no longer withstand the onslaught of the TD Outbreaks and was forced to retreat to the Gorges of Spirits, making their final stand. The warriors held their ground for days, fiercely battling as the defense lines were breached and reclaimed multiple times. During this time, the Waveworn Phenomenon across Huanglong appeared to be in an active phase, and it seemed as though the TDs were being led by a mysterious leader, aiming to converge in Inner Huanglong.

At the critical moment, reinforcements from the six cities were dispatched to the Gorges of Spirits, where the border warriors were still fighting with unwavering resolve. As the battle reached its peak, the appearance of the Crownless shattered the stalemate. Wherever the Crownless manifested, darkness enveloped the sky, and an oppressive atmosphere took hold, suffocating the warriors. Still, they held the line, willing to sacrifice themselves to buy time to destroy the entrance to the Gorges of Spirits and halt the TD Outbreak. They did so knowing it would trap most of them in Outer Huanglong with the TDs forever.
 
In that moment of life and death, a mighty Loong's roar emerged from the depths of the Gorges of Spirits, reverberating like thunder across the land. The roar burst forth from the Gorge, forcing back the TD army poised to flood in. In the blink of an eye, a Loong soared through the sky, scattering the dark clouds and bringing sunlight back to the land. Then, an otherworldly figure with golden eyes appeared, standing between the TDs and the warriors, confronting the Crownless in a fierce standoff. As the poem goes, "Armors gleam golden with Loong scales in the sun." As reinforcements from the six cities arrived, the united forces drove the TD Outbreaks and the Crownless back to the northern reaches of the Central Plains.
 
After this battle, Outer Huanglong was reborn from the ashes. The emergence of both the Threnodian and the holy creature signaled the need for a new city to rise and serve as Huanglong's border stronghold. Drawing inspiration from the "Jin" sound in "Guan Jin," meaning "the pass," and the form of Jin from the character symbolizing the roar of a Loong, this city was named Jinzhou.

A report from the Ministry of Development, archived in the City Hall. Its filing date suggests that it was submitted decades ago.
 
Infrastructure Division of the Ministry of Development in Jinzhou of Huanglong:
 
The Jinzhou Expansion Project Phase II has completed its initial preparation work. We are now submitting the land use application for construction approval. Below is the relevant information regarding the project:
 
I. Construction Undertaker Overview:
 
The Land Development Team of the Infrastructure Division is a construction project undertaker affiliated with Jinzhou's Ministry of Development, responsible for managing construction efforts in the Jinzhou region. Initially, the team consisted of 60 employees. Following the recruitment and transfers during the post-war period, the team has now grown to 400 ad-hoc members. This includes 31 individuals from the original staff, 190 transfers from Huaxu Academy, the Midnight Rangers, and the Defense Division of the Ministry of Development, 120 volunteers from Jinzhou, 50 transfers from other regions, and 9 individuals of unknown origin.

story_quest:StoryReview.source_en:
Mya heard those voices.

They incessantly reminded her of her failures, her lowly origin, and the disappointment she brought to her fans... The people who once shouted her name from the stands, laughing in celebration at her victories. That coarse, unrestrained laughter had at one time felt warm, giving her strength in the early days when she first stepped into the arena. But now, everything had changed.

Mya covers her ears, yet the voices still thunder in her mind, refusing to fade.
The finals were about to begin. In the empty locker room, she sits alone as shivers wrack her body and screams tear through her throat.
Mya is haunted by maddening voices that whisper constantly.
